questions.q: Which two raw materials does a plant use in photosynthesis?
questions.qAf: Watter twee grondstowwe gebruik 'n plant vir fotosintese?
questions.explain: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light energy → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. Carbon dioxide and water go in; glucose and oxygen come out.
questions.explainAf: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + ligenergie → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. Koolstofdioksied en water gaan in; glukose en suurstof kom uit.

questions.q: A sprinter's leg muscles burn at the end of a race. Which substance has built up in the muscles?
questions.qAf: 'n Naelloper se beenspiere brand aan die einde van 'n wedloop. Watter stof het in die spiere opgebou?
questions.explain: When oxygen runs short, muscles respire anaerobically and make lactic acid, which causes the burning feeling. Ethanol is made by yeast, not by animals.
questions.explainAf: Wanneer suurstof min raak, respireer spiere anaërobies en maak melksuur, wat die brandende gevoel veroorsaak. Etanol word deur gis gemaak, nie deur diere nie.

questions.q: Penicillin, the first antibiotic, was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928. What kind of micro-organism was it made from?
questions.qAf: Penisillien, die eerste antibiotikum, is in 1928 deur Alexander Fleming ontdek. Van watter soort mikro-organisme is dit gemaak?
questions.explain: Penicillin comes from the mould Penicillium, which is a fungus. It is one of the ways micro-organisms are useful in medicine.
questions.explainAf: Penisillien kom van die skimmel Penicillium, wat 'n swam is. Dit is een van die maniere waarop mikro-organismes in die geneeskunde nuttig is.

questions.q: Whose gold-foil experiment showed that most of an atom is empty space, with a tiny dense positive nucleus?
questions.qAf: Wie se goudfoelie-eksperiment het gewys dat die meeste van 'n atoom leë ruimte is, met 'n klein, digte positiewe kern?
questions.explain: Rutherford's nuclear model (1911) replaced Thomson's plum pudding model. Dalton thought atoms were solid spheres.
questions.explainAf: Rutherford se kernmodel (1911) het Thomson se pruimpoeding-model vervang. Dalton het gedink atome is soliede sfere.

questions.q: Potassium has 19 electrons. What is its electron arrangement?
questions.qAf: Kalium het 19 elektrone. Wat is sy elektronrangskikking?
questions.explain: For the first 20 elements, shell 3 takes up to 8 electrons and then shell 4 starts: 2 + 8 + 8 + 1 = 19.
questions.explainAf: Vir die eerste 20 elemente neem dop 3 tot 8 elektrone en dan begin dop 4: 2 + 8 + 8 + 1 = 19.

questions.q: Why is Mendeleev remembered for the periodic table?
questions.qAf: Waarom word Mendeleev onthou vir die periodieke tabel?
options: He left gaps for undiscovered elements and correctly predicted their properties
optionsAf: Hy het gapings gelaat vir onontdekte elemente en hul eienskappe korrek voorspel
questions.explain: Mendeleev arranged 63 elements and left gaps. Gallium, scandium and germanium were later found with the properties he predicted.
questions.explainAf: Mendeleev het 63 elemente gerangskik en gapings gelaat. Gallium, skandium en germanium is later gevind met die eienskappe wat hy voorspel het.

questions.q: Two balloons have both been rubbed on hair and are both negatively charged. What happens when they are held close together?
questions.qAf: Twee ballonne is albei teen hare gevryf en is albei negatief gelaai. Wat gebeur wanneer hulle naby aan mekaar gehou word?
questions.explain: Like charges repel; opposite charges attract.
questions.explainAf: Gelyke ladings stoot mekaar af; teenoorgestelde ladings trek mekaar aan.

questions.q: Which property of a sound wave decides its pitch?
questions.qAf: Watter eienskap van 'n klankgolf bepaal sy toonhoogte?
questions.explain: A higher frequency gives a higher pitch. Amplitude decides how loud the sound is.
questions.explainAf: 'n Hoër frekwensie gee 'n hoër toonhoogte. Amplitude bepaal hoe hard die klank is.

questions.q: What is the nearest star system to our Sun?
questions.qAf: Wat is die naaste sterstelsel aan ons Son?
options: Alpha Centauri, about 4.3 light years away
The Andromeda Galaxy, about 2.5 million light years away
The Moon, about 1.3 light seconds away
optionsAf: Die Andromeda-sterrestelsel, ongeveer 2,5 miljoen ligjaar weg
questions.explain: Alpha Centauri is the nearest star system. The Moon and Pluto are inside our own solar system, and Andromeda is a whole galaxy.
questions.explainAf: Alpha Centauri is die naaste sterstelsel. Die Maan en Pluto is binne ons eie sonnestelsel, en Andromeda is 'n hele sterrestelsel.

questions.q: What shape is the Milky Way?
questions.qAf: Watter vorm het die Melkweg?
questions.explain: The Milky Way is a barred spiral about 100 000 light years across. Our solar system is in one of its spiral arms.
questions.explainAf: Die Melkweg is 'n gebalkte spiraal van ongeveer 100 000 ligjaar breed. Ons sonnestelsel is in een van sy spiraalarms.

sections.title: Give ONE word or term
sections.intro: Write ONE word or term for each description.
sections.introAf: Skryf EEN woord of term vir elke beskrywing.

questions.q: A group of organisms of the same species living in the same area.
questions.qAf: ’n Groep organismes van dieselfde spesie wat in dieselfde gebied woon.

questions.q: Micro-organisms that cause disease.
questions.qAf: Mikro-organismes wat siektes veroorsaak.

questions.q: A change in which new substances are formed.
questions.qAf: ’n Verandering waarin nuwe stowwe gevorm word.

questions.q: The unit in which electric current is measured.
questions.qAf: Die eenheid waarin elektriese stroom gemeet word.

questions.q: The band of colours formed when white light is split by a prism.
questions.qAf: Die band kleure wat gevorm word wanneer wit lig deur ’n prisma verdeel word.

questions.q: A natural satellite that orbits a planet.
questions.qAf: ’n Natuurlike satelliet wat om ’n planeet wentel.

sections.title: Fill in the missing words
sections.intro: Type the word that is missing in each space.
sections.introAf: Tik die woord wat in elke spasie ontbreek.

questions.q: Fill in the missing words.
questions.qAf: Vul die ontbrekende woorde in.
questions.text: In a solid the particles are packed [[]] together and can only [[]] in place.
questions.textAf: In ’n vaste stof is die deeltjies [[]] opmekaar gepak en kan hulle net op hul plek [[]].

questions.q: Fill in the missing words.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: During the day, a healthy plant photosynthesises faster than it respires.
questions.qAf: Bedags fotosinteer 'n gesonde plant vinniger as wat dit respireer.
questions.explain: True. So in daylight a plant takes in more CO₂ than it gives out, and releases oxygen.
questions.explainAf: Waar. In daglig neem 'n plant dus meer CO₂ in as wat dit afgee, en dit stel suurstof vry.

questions.q: The noble gases in Group 18 are very reactive.
questions.qAf: Die edelgasse in Groep 18 is baie reaktief.
questions.explain: False. Their outer shells are full, so they do not gain or lose electrons. They are used in lighting and as inert atmospheres.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Hul buitenste doppe is vol, dus kry of verloor hulle nie elektrone nie. Hulle word in beligting en as onaktiewe atmosfere gebruik.

questions.q: Dissolving sugar in water is a chemical change.
questions.qAf: Om suiker in water op te los, is 'n chemiese verandering.
questions.explain: False. It is a physical change: no new substance forms, and you can get the sugar back by evaporating the water.
questions.explainAf: Onwaar. Dit is 'n fisiese verandering: geen nuwe stof vorm nie, en jy kan die suiker terugkry deur die water te laat verdamp.

questions.q: Static shocks are more common on dry days than on humid days.
questions.qAf: Statiese skokke kom meer op droë dae as op vogtige dae voor.
questions.explain: True. Humid air lets charge leak away more easily, so less charge builds up.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Vogtige lug laat lading makliker weglek, dus bou minder lading op.

questions.q: In a series circuit, if one bulb breaks, all the bulbs go out.
questions.qAf: In 'n seriestroombaan gaan al die gloeilampe af as een gloeilamp breek.
questions.explain: True. There is only one loop, so a break anywhere stops the current everywhere.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Daar is net een lus, dus stop 'n breuk enige plek die stroom oral.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each feeding role in column A with a South African example in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke voedingsrol in kolom A by 'n Suid-Afrikaanse voorbeeld in kolom B.
questions.explain: Acacia trees make their own food, impala eat plants, jackals eat primary consumers, and dung beetles break down dead organic matter.
questions.explainAf: Akasiabome maak hul eie voedsel, rooibokke eet plante, jakkalse eet primêre verbruikers, en miskruiers breek dooie organiese materiaal af.

questions.q: Match each group of the periodic table in column A with its name in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke groep van die periodieke tabel in kolom A by sy naam in kolom B.
questions.explain: Group 1 is the alkali metals, Group 17 the halogens and Group 18 the noble gases. The transition metals are Groups 3–12.
questions.explainAf: Groep 1 is die alkalimetale, Groep 17 die halogene en Groep 18 die edelgasse. Die oorgangsmetale is Groepe 3–12.

questions.q: Match each type of galaxy in column A with its description in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke soort sterrestelsel in kolom A by sy beskrywing in kolom B.
pairs: A flat disc with spiral arms, like Andromeda
No regular shape, like the Magellanic Clouds
pairsAf: 'n Plat skyf met spiraalarms, soos Andromeda
Geen gereelde vorm nie, soos die Magelhaanse Wolke
extra: A ring of planets around one star
questions.explain: Spiral galaxies are flat discs with arms, elliptical galaxies are ball-shaped, and irregular galaxies have no regular shape.
questions.explainAf: Spiraalvormige sterrestelsels is plat skywe met arms, elliptiese sterrestelsels is balvormig, en onreëlmatige sterrestelsels het geen gereelde vorm nie.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put these media in order from the slowest speed of sound to the fastest.
questions.qAf: Plaas hierdie mediums in volgorde van die stadigste klankspoed tot die vinnigste.
questions.explain: Sound travels slowest in gases, faster in liquids and fastest in solids, where the particles are closest together.
questions.explainAf: Klank beweeg die stadigste in gasse, vinniger in vloeistowwe en die vinnigste in vaste stowwe, waar die deeltjies die naaste aan mekaar is.

questions.q: Put these planets in order, from the closest to the Sun to the farthest.
questions.qAf: Plaas hierdie planete in volgorde, van die naaste aan die Son tot die verste.
questions.explain: The full order is Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune: My Very Energetic Mother Just Served Us Nachos.
questions.explainAf: Die volle volgorde is Mercurius, Venus, Aarde, Mars, Jupiter, Saturnus, Uranus, Neptunus.

sections.title: Calculation and short answers
sections.intro: Show the answer in the box. For the written question you mark your own answer against the memo after you hand in.
sections.introAf: Gee die antwoord in die blokkie. Vir die geskrewe vraag merk jy jou eie antwoord teen die memorandum nadat jy ingehandig het.

questions.q: Light travels at 300 000 km/s. How far does light travel in 480 s (8 minutes), the time it takes to reach us from the Sun? Give your answer in km.
questions.qAf: Lig beweeg teen 300 000 km/s. Hoe ver beweeg lig in 480 s (8 minute), die tyd wat dit neem om ons vanaf die Son te bereik? Gee jou antwoord in km.

questions.q: Explain why we see a ripe apple as red.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom ons ’n ryp appel as rooi sien.
points: The apple reflects red light into our eyes
It absorbs all the other colours of white light
pointsAf: Die appel weerkaats rooi lig na ons oë
Dit absorbeer al die ander kleure van wit lig

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: A learner puts an Elodea water plant in water and places a lamp 10 cm, 20 cm, 30 cm and then 40 cm away. Each time she counts the oxygen bubbles the plant gives off in one minute.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Leerder sit 'n Elodea-waterplant in water en plaas 'n lamp 10 cm, 20 cm, 30 cm en dan 40 cm weg. Elke keer tel sy die suurstofborrels wat die plant in een minuut afgee.

questions.q: What is the independent variable (the one she changes)?
questions.qAf: Wat is die onafhanklike veranderlike (die een wat sy verander)?
options: The distance of the lamp (light intensity)
questions.explain: She chooses the lamp distance, which changes the light intensity. The bubbles are what she measures.
questions.explainAf: Sy kies die lamp se afstand, wat die ligintensiteit verander. Die borrels is wat sy meet.

questions.q: What is the dependent variable (the one she measures)?
questions.qAf: Wat is die afhanklike veranderlike (die een wat sy meet)?
options: The number of oxygen bubbles per minute
questions.explain: The bubbles of oxygen show how fast photosynthesis is happening, so they are the dependent variable.
questions.explainAf: Die suurstofborrels wys hoe vinnig fotosintese plaasvind, dus is hulle die afhanklike veranderlike.

questions.q: Which of these should she keep the same (a control variable)?
questions.qAf: Watter een hiervan moet sy dieselfde hou ('n kontroleveranderlike)?
options: None of them; everything may change
questions.explain: Temperature also affects the rate of photosynthesis, so it must stay the same for a fair test. The same plant and the same amount of CO₂ are other controls.
questions.explainAf: Temperatuur beïnvloed ook die tempo van fotosintese, dus moet dit dieselfde bly vir 'n regverdige toets. Dieselfde plant en dieselfde hoeveelheid CO₂ is ander kontroles.

questions.q: As the lamp moves further away, she should count fewer bubbles per minute.
questions.qAf: Soos die lamp verder weg skuif, behoort sy minder borrels per minuut te tel.
questions.explain: True. Further away means less light, so photosynthesis slows down and less oxygen is made.
questions.explainAf: Waar. Verder weg beteken minder lig, dus gaan fotosintese stadiger en word minder suurstof gemaak.

questions.scenario: Three blocks each have a volume of 100 cm³. Block A (cork) has a mass of 24 g, block B (aluminium) 270 g and block C (iron) 790 g. Density = mass ÷ volume. Water has a density of 1 g/cm³.
questions.scenarioAf: Drie blokke het elk 'n volume van 100 cm³. Blok A (kurk) het 'n massa van 24 g, blok B (aluminium) 270 g en blok C (yster) 790 g. Digtheid = massa ÷ volume. Water het 'n digtheid van 1 g/cm³.

questions.q: What is the density of the cork block?
questions.qAf: Wat is die digtheid van die kurkblok?

whyWrong.1: Divided by 10 instead of 100 when converting the volume.
whyWrong.2: Gave the mass only and did not divide by the volume.
whyWrong.3: Added the mass and the volume (24 + 100).

whyWrongAf.1: Deur 10 gedeel in plaas van 100 toe die volume omgeskakel is.
whyWrongAf.2: Net die massa gegee en nie deur die volume gedeel nie.
whyWrongAf.3: Die massa en die volume bymekaar getel (24 + 100).

questions.q: Which block would float on water?
questions.qAf: Watter blok sou op water dryf?
questions.explain: Only cork (0.24 g/cm³) is less dense than water. Aluminium (2.7 g/cm³) and iron (7.9 g/cm³) are denser, so they sink.
questions.explainAf: Net kurk (0,24 g/cm³) is minder dig as water. Aluminium (2,7 g/cm³) en yster (7,9 g/cm³) is digter, dus sink hulle.

questions.q: Why is the iron block so much heavier than the cork block of the same size?
questions.qAf: Waarom is die ysterblok soveel swaarder as die kurkblok van dieselfde grootte?
options: Its particles are heavier and more closely packed
Its particles are bigger and further apart
It contains air between its particles
optionsAf: Sy deeltjies is swaarder en digter gepak
Sy deeltjies is groter en verder uitmekaar
Dit bevat lug tussen sy deeltjies
questions.explain: A material has a high density when its particles are heavy and closely packed. The spaces between particles are empty, not filled with air.
questions.explainAf: 'n Materiaal het 'n hoë digtheid wanneer sy deeltjies swaar en dig gepak is. Die ruimtes tussen deeltjies is leeg, nie met lug gevul nie.
